notes: Kayak grounded on the gravel, looking downstream. The observer waited through Kholo Creek high water (about 12:00, 1.85 m) to see if the tide would drown the run; it never did that day.
Calm water about 0.9 km above the Colleges Crossing run, on the way back down.
Whitewater over the gravel and rocks under the bridge, flowing strongly downstream into the tidal water below (fresh in character). Kholo Creek was rising from low water (about 08:10, 0.15 m).
